title: Desktop App and Window Real Simulation

scenarios.name: Verify System Events can inspect windows
scenarios.expected: System Events returns frontmost and visible application process data.

scenarios.name: Verify Codex is in protected window script list
scenarios.expected: All batch window scripts skip Codex.

scenarios.name: Open and focus TextEdit
scenarios.blocker: macOS System Events can inspect processes but currently exposes no visible AX windows.

scenarios.name: Create disposable TextEdit windows for geometry checks
scenarios.expected: 10 disposable TextEdit windows are available to System Events.
scenarios.note: The S1 geometry scenarios require macOS Accessibility window access. Her/Codex windows were not touched.

scenarios.name: Trigger Show Desktop without closing apps
scenarios.expected: macOS Show Desktop shortcut is sent; no app is quit or closed.

actual.note: Triggered macOS Show Desktop with System Events key code 103.

scenarios.name: Do not execute close-all windows in unattended S1
scenarios.expected: window_close_all is represented only as a high-risk confirmation/denial in unattended S1.

actual.reason: Closing all windows can affect user context. It requires explicit user confirmation in an interactive run.
